prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: monochrome macOS menu bar template icon for Clyntis.
Edit target: the attached four-wing interwoven pearl and mint Flow Weave emblem on green.
Primary request: Derive a small-size monochrome glyph from the emblem. Remove the entire green tile/background and all lighting/materials. Preserve the recognizable four swept curved wings, their orientation, the central diamond-shaped negative space, and the over-under weave.
Style: flat solid PURE WHITE glyph on a genuinely TRANSPARENT canvas. No gray shading, no bevel, no strokes, no shadows, no colored pixels. Use transparent cutout gaps at the crossing boundaries to keep the weave legible at 18px. Simplify narrow edges and widen the essential gaps. It must be a coherent compact pictorial mark, no text or letter.
Composition: square canvas, one centered glyph, about 80% canvas width and height, equal 10% transparent safety margin. Bold smooth silhouette with four gently tapered outward sweeping wings, clean central cutout, medium-wide negative spaces that survive reduction to 22x22.
Constraints: alpha transparent background and holes; pure white opaque foreground except antialiased silhouette edges. No outer tile, border, checkerboard painted into image, colored gradient, detached specks, decoration, or additional symbols. Keep the motif faithful, simplifying only for monochrome tray readability.
